svg.title: Project Memoria Qwen Cloud architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of Project Memoria showing home cameras and microphones, local capture and ingestion, the FastAPI and Jeeves backend, MongoDB and Chroma memory stores, Alibaba OSS and Qwen Cloud models, the React patient web app, proactive Web Push delivery, Gemini fallback paths, and caretaker-only fall alerts.
svg.text: A memory-grounded dementia assistant: local perception, durable evidence, grounded recall, and proactive care.

g.text: The Qwen submission uses the Qwen provider profile. OpenAI and Ollama profiles remain supported alternatives, but they are not active in this diagram.
No patient voice/TTS · No ECS boundary · Current implementation as of July 20, 2026
